row.text:
Once upon a time, there was a leaf. The leaf wanted to rise up high in the sky, like a kite. It tried to flap its edges, but the wind was too slow. 

So the leaf found an idea. It decided to find something sour. It saw a lemon and asked it for a little bit of help. The lemon was sour and strong enough that it could help the leaf rise up high. The leaf felt the sour lemon push it up and up until it was higher than the clouds!

The leaf was so happy that it was flying. It spread its edges to go even higher. It flew over the trees, houses, and even the ocean! 

Finally, after a long journey, the leaf had to come down. But it had made its dream come true, and it had risen higher than it ever thought possible!

One day, a rat was in the garden, and he saw a mysterious hole. He was curious and wanted to explore it. So, he bravely went in.

Suddenly, he felt like he was in a prison, walls everywhere. He was scared and wanted to get out, but he could not find the way.

The rat tried to find his way out but it was no use. He looked around and saw a big cat, staring at him. 

The rat knew he was doomed, and so he surrendered. The cat let him go free.

The rat was so happy to be free. He learnt from his mistake and never went inside mysterious places again.

Once upon a time, there lived a strong princess. She lived in a big castle and every day she tried to find something special. One day, she tried to find a diamond. She searched the castle high and low, but she could not find one.

The princess was very sad and she decided to go outside and look for a diamond. She went to the forest and looked everywhere. She climbed trees and looked in bushes, but she still could not find a diamond.

The princess wasn't very happy, so she decided to try one more time. She went to the river and tried to find a diamond there. The river was very deep and the princess was scared, but she had to keep looking. Suddenly, she saw a sparkle at the bottom of the river. She dived into the water and found the biggest diamond she had ever seen!

The princess was so happy and she took the diamond back to her castle. She kept it safe in the castle forever and told everyone about her special diamond.

Jill was hungry so she went to the kitchen. She looked inside the cupboards and chose a dish. The dish was filled with delicious food. She picked up a spoon and started eating. Then she heard a noise outside. It was her dog, Max. He was looking at her, wagging his tail. She wanted to take Max for a walk. She put her dish down and chose her leash. She was a little bit lazy so she put her shoes on and slowly walked outside with Max. They chose to go down a path to the park. Soon enough they were there and it was a beautiful day. Max ran around and Jill enjoyed the sunshine. After a while, Jill decided to go back home. She put Max in the house and was ready for another delicious dish.

Once upon a time, there was a white leopard who was very tired. So, he went to sleep under a big tree.

The leopard slept and slept for a long time. He dreamed about running and playing all day.

When he woke up, he saw something beautiful. Right in front of his eyes was a white butterfly! He watched it flutter and fly around.

The leopard was so happy that he jumped and yelled. Then he went back to sleep under the big tree so he could have more wonderful dreams.

The leopard slept and slept until a big night. Then, he silently snuck away in the shadows and ran back to his home. The white leopard had a wonderful day, and he went to bed with a big smile on his face.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Joe. Joe was three years old and he loved to explore the world.

One day, Joe went outside. He saw a big puddle and he decided to jump in it! But when he tried to jump, he slipped and almost fell in.

Luckily, his mom came to help him. She put her arm around him and gave him a big hug. She said, "Don't worry, I'm here to support you!" Joe thanked her and he felt much better.

Then, Joe had a very creative idea! He gave his mom a big smile and said, "Let's jump together!" So they jumped into the puddle, and they had so much fun!

Afterwards, Joe and his mom held hands and they laughed together. Joe was so happy and he thanked his mom for all her support. Joe and his mom continued to explore the world together!

Teddy was very excited. He was going camping with his family. Dad carried the tent and Teddy helped too. 

When they arrived at the campsite, they got to work. Dad put the tent up with some help of Teddy. Then they kneeled on the grass and Teddy saw a magpie. 

After the tent was pitched, Teddy and his family had a picnic. They ate apples and sandwiches under the tent. 

It was getting dark, so Teddy and his family got ready for bed. They kneeled down and said their prayers before getting into the tent. 

In the morning, Teddy was excited to go on an adventure! He couldn't wait to explore the woods and find out what was waiting.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Annie. She was three years old and loved to play. One day she was playing in the garden with her pet dog. Suddenly, the pet dog jumped onto the grass and Annie heard a pop. When she looked around, she saw that her shoe was gone! 

Annie was very sad and started to cry. Her mom came out to see what was wrong and Annie told her about the shoe. Mom knew Annie needed a new shoe so she said it was time to go to the store.

At the store, Mom told Annie to pick out the shoes she liked. Annie looked around and saw all of the different shoes. Eventually, she chose a serious looking pair of black shoes.

Once the shoe was on, Annie felt so much better. She thanked her mom for helping her find the right shoe and said she was ready to play again. Mom smiled and they both went back into the garden to continue their fun time. 

The end.

Once upon a time, in a sunny meadow, there lived a fast little kitten. Each day, the kitten would run around the meadow, chasing after butterflies.

One day, she heard something strange coming from the trees. She stopped to listen and heard a strange sound repeating over and over again. It sounded like, "meow, meow". So, the kitten slowly walked closer, and saw a tiny, little kitten meowing. It was so little and scared, so the fast kitten went up to it and said, "meow".

The little kitten stopped meowing and looked up happily at her new friend. It then said, "meow" again and jumped up to give the fast kitten a big hug. The fast kitten was so happy that she said, "meow" back and started to cuddle and play with the little one.

They both continued to play and repeat, "meow". They could not stop and became the best of friends for life.

Once upon a time, there was a normal deer. The deer went outside to play in the sun and look for something to do. 
The deer went to a nearby field and the field included lots of things the deer could play with. 
The deer saw some horses, cows, and sheep. It also saw some squirrels and birds. 
The deer had a great time playing in the field with the animals. It even made some new friends. 
The deer spent the whole day in the field, playing and having fun with its new animal friends. 
When the day was done, the deer went home feeling happy and content. It could not wait to come back and play with its friends again. The end.

One day Bob decided to perform an experiment. He opened a small chamber and examined what was inside. To his surprise, he found lots of broken bits lying inside. Using these broken pieces, Bob decided to perform a test. He put the broken bits and pieces together and, slowly but surely, he began to put them back together again. After several attempts, Bob was pleased to discover a perfect functioning chamber! Bob was so proud of his work that he showed it off to his friends. They were amazed by his clever experiment!

Once upon a time there was a boy named Tommy. Tommy was three years old and he loved to whistle. One day after his dinner, Tommy grabbed his dirty plate and whistled a happy tune. He went out into the garden and sat under the apple tree.

As Tommy whistled, the birds began to sing along. He watched them fly from branch to branch and it made him whistle even louder. All he wanted was to keep on singing and whistling with the birds, so he just kept going.

When it started to get dark, Tommy's mom called him to come inside. As he walked back in, he blew one last big whistle at the birds. They all flew away, leaving only the sound of Tommy's whistling in the air.

Once upon a time there was a board. It was placed on top of a hill and no one knew why it was there. One day, a little boy took a walk to the top of the hill to examine the board. He was very curious and wanted to know why the board was alone at the top of the hill. When he looked closely he could see that the board was very stupid. The words written on the board made no sense. The little boy was really confused. He decided to move the board to find out more. He pushed and pulled and eventually the board moved away to reveal a big hole in the ground. The little boy was so excited and decided to explore the hole. Finally, he learned why the board was there. It was left by a group of pirates to mark the entrance to their secret treasure!

Bob was a little boy who had a new neighbor. He was excited to meet them but he was also a bit scared. Bob's neighbor was very big and he was speaking with a deep, rough voice. Bob didn't know what to do, so he decided to rest for a bit. He sat down on the porch and closed his eyes. 

The neighbor saw Bob and he smiled. He came close and Bob was surprised, but he felt safe. The neighbor asked Bob if he wanted to play a game and Bob said yes! 

They played all afternoon and Bob was getting tired. The neighbor said that it was time to rest and Bob happily agreed. He said goodbye and went back home. 

Bob was now sure that his new neighbor was very nice, even if his voice had been a bit scary and rough before. He was grateful that they were friends.

The sun peeked over the horizon and the day began. Emily happily gazed out her window at the new day. She saw the trees and birds and felt so full of joy. Emily could not wait to start her day. 

She put on her clothes and headed to the kitchen. There she saw a big table filled with all sorts of healthy food. Emily was ready to eat! She scooped a big spoonful of oatmeal and squished it in her mouth. The taste was so delicious!

Emily smiled and started to walk outside. She gazed up with wonder at the bright blue sky and all the birds flying around. Everything was so peaceful and beautiful. Emily took a deep breath and smiled. 

She spent the day running around in the park, exploring and playing with her friends. Before Emily knew it, the sun was setting, and it was time to go. 

Emily gave one last gaze of the beautiful day, full of sunshine and fresh air, and headed home happy and content.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Gemma. She liked to draw pictures and was very good at it. One day, Gemma's mom demanded that she take a picture of the park.

Gemma grabbed her art supplies and went to the park. It was very noisy. There were kids playing and people talking. Gemma quickly set up her easel and grabbed her colored pencils. She then began to draw the scene around her.

She worked hard and created the best picture she had ever drawn. Gemma was so pleased with her drawing that she ran back home to show her mom.

When Gemma showed her mom the picture, she was delighted. She gave Gemma a big hug and praised her. From then on, Gemma was always ready to demand better when it came to her artwork.

Once upon a time there was a farmer who owned a bull. The bull was very special, but the farmer was a bit jealous. So, one day, the farmer decided to take the bull to wander around the farm.

The bull was very happy. He wandered around and ate some juicy grass. He was so content that he even stopped to have a nap in the sun. But then, he heard a noise. It was loud and made him jump.

It was the farmer. He was mad and was shouting. The farmer was jealous that the bull was so enjoying himself. He yelled at the bull to come back. The bull ran back to the farmer and the farmer put him on his farm.

But, the bull knew he was meant to wander and would often find ways to wander around the farm during the day. He was always happy when he did this and so the farmer was always jealous.

The end.

Once there was a chubby bee who liked to zoom. He zoomed around his garden all day long, looking for places to explore. One day, he noticed a vase sitting on the ledge of the garden wall. He was very curious, so he zipped over to have a closer look. The glass was shiny and there were lots of pretty flowers inside. He wanted to see the flowers better, so he zoomed around to the other side and touched the vase. Suddenly, it tipped over, and the flowers and water spilled out! He quickly buzzed away, worried that he had made a mess. But then he heard a voiceâ€”it was his momma! She said, "Don't worry, my little bee. We can fix it." And so they did, with a little help from Momma. After all the flowers were back in the vase, they both admired it and then the chubby bee continued to zoom around the garden. The end.

Once upon a time there was an cool dragon. It loved to explore and fly around the world. One day it came across a peaceful village and decided to settle there. It made its home in a cave near the village. Everyone was very excited to have a dragon living close by!

The dragon was so friendly and kind, it helped the villagers with all sorts of tasks. It flew high up in the sky to collect clouds for rain, and loved playing hide and seek with the children. On hot days it cooled down the village by blowing a gentle breeze.

The villagers were so happy to have their dragon friend. They even threw a special party for it! The dragon had a wonderful time, and settled back in its cave when the night ended.

The dragon and the villagers became good friends. And to this day, he still visits the village, bringing cool winds and fun adventures.

One day, a boy was ready to paint. He grabbed his paints, a brush and smiled. He wanted to make something special. He painted many blue and green lines, circles and squares.

The boy wanted to make a war. With his paints, he painted a picture of two armies facing each other. They were ready for battle. He used honest colors like blue and green.

Suddenly, a loud noise scared the boy. He stopped painting and did not want to be a part of the war. He wanted to play and be happy. He cleaned his brushes and put away his paints.

The boy decided to paint something more peaceful. He painted a scene of a bright sunny day with a river, trees and birds in the sky. He put all the honest colors on his canvas.

The boy felt proud of what he painted and smiled. He realized thereâ€™s no reason to paint a war when he could share so much beauty.

John was a little boy. He loved to run! Every morning he would get up and run outside to the big green park. He was so fast, no one could catch him. One day, John saw something that he had never seen before. In the middle of the park was a giant green knot! He had never seen a knot so big. He wanted to know what it was and so he ran over to it. John was very curious, so he slowly reached out and touched it. All of a sudden, the knot slowly started to bounce and wiggle. John was so surprised that he started to giggle and run away. He ran and ran, until he finally got tired and stopped. He looked back and the knot was gone. He was so excited that he could not stop smiling. He ran back home and told everyone about the big green knot he had found!

Once there was a little girl. She loved to play outside with her scooter. Every day she would pick it up and ride around the yard. She liked to pretend she was a big racer.

But one day, something happened. When the little girl was riding her scooter, she heard a scary noise! She was scared, but she kept going. Then she saw something even more scary - a big monster!

The little girl was so scared she dropped her scooter and ran away as fast as she could. She ran all the way home and she never picked up the scooter again. She was too scared to go back.

But the really amazing thing happened later that day. The monster was gone. In its place was a kind old lady! She gave the little girl a big hug and said, "Don't be scared. You can pick up your scooter anytime you want."

The little girl smiled and thanked the old lady. From then on, she was no longer scared to ride her scooter. She picked it up and went riding every day!

Once upon a time there was a wise old man who wanted to organize his day. He had many things to do, but he was determined to get everything done. First, he started with a big smile on his face. He was excited to start his day. He made a plan and set out to do his tasks one by one with determination.

After he finished all his tasks he felt very satisfied. He looked at his face in the mirror and saw that the smile was still there. He was happy that he was able to organize his day so well. He was able to get a lot done and still have some time to relax and enjoy the day.

He knew that being wise, organized and having a smile on his face was the key to having a successful day. He was proud of himself for proving just how wise and organized he could be. He knew that he had made a wise decision by taking the time to organize his day. He smiled a big smile and went off to enjoy the rest of his day.

Once upon a time, there was a mom and a dad who were very happy together. They loved each other very much and wanted to be together forever. One day, they decided to raise their hands and say nice things to each other in front of all their family and friends. This special thing was called a marriage.

The mom and dad were so excited and had a big party to share the news with everyone they knew. But then one day, the mom got angry. She was mad and yelled at the dad, and they started to fight. 

The mom and dad loved each other, but their fighting was causing them a lot of sadness. They decided to talk to each other and try to understand why the mom was so angry. After talking, the mom and dad hugged and said sorry to each other. 

The mom and dad worked hard and showed each other how much they loved each other. Even though sometimes they still got angry, they kept trying to talk and understand and found peace in their marriage. 
The End.

Once upon a time, a little raven flew from its nest in search of something special. After flying for a while, the raven spotted a bright lake. As it perched on a nearby tree, it heard the most beautiful music coming from the lake.

The raven flew closer and saw a little girl by the lake's edge. In her hands the girl held a beautiful golden flute. She played her music which made the raven so happy that it began to dance.

The girl laughed and put down her flute. She looked up at the raven and said: "Oh, little raven, please accept my gift of music." The raven hopped down from the tree and lightly ate from the girl's hand. From then on the raven visited the girl every day and accepted her gift of music.

The little raven and the girl became great friends. They both enjoyed each others company and the music the girl played. The little raven looked forward to hearing the girl's music each and every day.

Once upon a time there was a girl who loved cocoa. Every day, she would go for a walk, and if she found a cocoa tree, she'd shake it to see if any cocoa beans would fall down.

One day, she found a really big tree in the forest. She was so excited and quickly started shaking it. Suddenly, lots of cocoa beans fell down, and they all rolled into the forest.

The girl was eager to find them again, so she started running through the forest to find them. She ran and ran until she came to a clearing with a river. In the river, she could see some of the cocoa beans floating around.

But the river was very deep and the water was very rough. She couldn't get close enough to the beans without falling in, so she had to find another way.

Then she saw a big stick. She grabbed it and started using it to push the beans back to the shore. After a few minutes of hard work, she managed to get all the cocoa beans out of the river safely.

She was so happy, and she collected the beans in her pocket and headed home. From that day on, she kept going back to the river to collect cocoa beans whenever she wanted a hot cup of cocoa.

One day, there was a special kind of girl. She was very curious about the world. Every day she asked lots of questions and explored the day with a sense of wonder.

One night, when she was tucked into bed, the girl heard a loud noise. She began to cry because she was scared. But then she remembered her mum and dad were there. She told them how scared she was and they gave her a hug. They told her she was safe and then they all hugged.

The girl felt better and she said sorry for being scared. Her parents smiled and said it was okay. They said they understood and they were happy she knew to talk to them. The girl hugged them again, thankful they had forgiven her. 

The girl was so happy that she hugged them every day from then on. And she promised to be more curious with her wonders and questions, instead of being scared.

Once upon a time, there was a young boy who wanted to go on an adventure. He wanted to explore a big, scary maze. But he couldn't find his way out. He felt so helpless.

Suddenly, he heard a voice calling his name. He turned around and saw a friendly, shining light. It was an angel! The angel said it would bring the boy out of the maze, and that it would guide him to safety.

The angel flew up above and shone a light on the path ahead. The boy followed the light and eventually made it out of the maze. He was so happy! He thanked the angel for bringing him out of the maze and back home again.

The angel smiled and said, â€œIt was my pleasure!â€ Then, it flew off into the sky and the boy went back inside his house. He was so relieved he had made it out of the maze. From that day on he never ventured into a maze again!

Once there was a boy called Jake. Jake loved to play in the park with his friends. One day, he was playing in the park when he fell. He was so scared and he didn't know what to do. He started to worry.

His mom saw him from the other side of the park and ran over to help. Jake was still scared but when he saw his mom everything felt normal. She picked him up and hugged him.

Jake's mom kissed him on the forehead. She smiled and said "it's ok, these things happen". Jake felt better now and wasn't worried anymore. He hugged his mom and they started to play together in the park.

Once upon a time, there was an amazing orange. It was a special orange, because it could repeat everything it heard. One day, a three year old boy came across the orange. The boy was so excited. He said "Hello orange!" and the orange said "Hello!" right back.

The little boy couldn't believe it. He kept talking so the orange could repeat the words over and over again. He asked the orange to sing a song, so the orange sang "Twinkle, twinkle little star". The boy was so amazed that he sang right along with the orange.

The boy and his orange had so much fun together. Each day they played and talked. The little boy was so happy. He loved his amazing orange.

Once upon a time, in a faraway land, there lived two friends: Bill and Ben. They were always happy together and had lots of fun. 

One day, however, they had a quarrel. Bill did not want to play with Ben anymore and thought he was too annoying. This made Ben very sad and he started to cry.

High above the two friends, in the sky, a delicate cloud appeared. It was very white and fluffy and the sunbeams shone straight through. From up inside the cloud, it started to rain ever so gently. 

The gentle rainfall washed away all their quarrel and sadness. They smiled at each other and realised they could still be friends, no matter what. 

Then, they set off and had lots of fun together, just like they used to.

Mum and Dad were talking to each other. They were discussing something. Suddenly, Dad took an envelope from his pocket. It was mum's birthday present. Mum opened the envelope, and inside there was a tasty cake!

Mum was so excited. She took the cake, and she smiled. She hugged Dad and thanked him. She said the cake was very tasty. Everyone was very happy.

Mum and Dad then sat down and ate the cake together. They were talking and laughing. They were very happy. They discussed how tasty the cake was, and how much they enjoyed it.

The cake made everyone happy and it was a wonderful birthday present. Everyone agreed that cake was really tasty and they were glad they discussed it.

One day, Alex went to the kitchen. His eyes lit up with enthusiasm when he saw a big cup of juice. Alex stared at it in delight and smiled. Then he drank some. He liked it so much he wanted some more. He asked his mom if he could have some more, and she agreed. So Alex had an even bigger cup of juice.

He was really enjoying it. His excitement increased as he drank the second cup. He finished the second cup and wanted more. Alex's mom said no, but he was so enthusiastic she could not resist his pleading. So she gave Alex a third cup of juice.

Alex was so happy he was jumping up and down with joy. He felt full after drinking three big cups of juice. He thanked his mom and went off to play.

Once upon a time there lived a sweet little girl called Elle. She was three years old and loved to play. One day Elle saw in the sky a bright, shiny laser. She wanted to touch it so she clapped her hands loudly.

The laser heard her so it came nearer and nearer. Elle was so excited and clapped harder and harder until the laser was within reach. But the laser kept going around and around, just a little out of Elle's reach.

Elle kept trying to catch the laser, clapping and shouting in excitement. She was very persistent and didn't give up until the laser finally let her catch it. Elle was delighted and proudly carried the laser home. Afterwards, Elle spent the rest of the day playing with her new laser toy.

Once upon a time, there was an infant who loved to play. Every day, she would explore her distant world. One day, she looked up and saw two bright moons in the sky. She was so amazed, she waved her little arms in joy.

The infant's mom loved to watch her daughter so full of joy and love. She was so thankful to be a mom seeing her infant be so curious.The infant's happiness was infectious! Whenever anyone saw her, they couldn't help but smile too.

The infant loved her mom and dad, and they too loved her very much. They would take her out to different places to play, and although some of the places were distant, the infant loved exploring and being with the people she loved. 

The infant was so loved. Everywhere she went, she was surrounded by a big warm hug of love.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She was only three years old, and was playing in her backyard one day. She was so happy and excited to be outside. 

Then all of a sudden, Lucy heard a loud noise. She was very worried. She looked up to see a big bird staring at her. Lucy gulped and bowed her head. The bird kept looking at her with its beady eyes.

Lucy got scared. She ran and hid behind a tree. She stayed there for a few minutes until the bird flew away. She was relieved. 

She peeked out from her hiding spot and saw something shiny on the ground. She bent down and picked it up. It was a tiny nose! 

She put it back where it belonged and smiled. Then she ran inside to tell her mom about her scared, but exciting adventure.

Sandy was a kind 3 year old girl. One day, she was in her bedroom playing. She wanted to make a surprise for her mom and dad. Sandy had an idea! She took off her pants and filled them with stuffing from her old pillow. After she was done, she put the pants on the floor. Then she clapped her hands and said 'rise!'  Suddenly, the stuffed pants rose up. Sandy clapped and laughed. She knew that mom and dad would love her surprise. Sandy gave the stuffed pants a big hug. She was so happy that her special surprise was finished. 

Now, Sandy could show her parents her special surprise. She ran into the living room and said "Look mom and dad, I made something special". Mom and dad admired Sandy's surprise. They were so proud of her. Sandy smiled, she knew that she had made something special with her kind heart.

Once upon a time, there was an ordinary penguin. He was walking around looking for something to do when he came across a printer. He had never seen anything like it before. The penguin was very curious. He stepped up to the printer and pressed a button.

Much to his surprise, the printer started to make noise. Out came a piece of paper with pictures on it. The penguin was amazed. He was so excited that he ran around showing all his friends. 

The penguin then spread the word that if you press the button on the printer something new will get printed. All his friends wanted to try it out and from then on the penguin was known as the printing penguin!

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a pig. He loved to explore. One day, he went on an adventure. As he was walking, he found something interesting. He could not wait to see what it was! When he got closer, he was so excited to reveal the secret. It was a shiny golden coin. He was so happy, he shouted with joy and took the coin home. He was sure it was a big treasure and he would be able to keep it forever. The pig was so proud of his special coin and never forgot that day.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who was like most children her age; she loved playing and having fun. One day she decided to take a walk to the nearby park. As she was walking, she noticed an ice-cream stand. She was so excited to see it, and she ran up to get some ice-cream. 

Suddenly, she saw something move in the bush nearby. She was fearful, so she stopped and looked around. Then, to her surprise, she saw a rabbit! She was so excited, she tried to catch it. 

But the rabbit was too fast for the little girl and it jumped away. She chased it until, suddenly, it stopped in front of the ice-cream stand. She caught it and carefully held it in her arms. 

The little girl was so proud of herself. She smiled as she thought of how she could bring the rabbit home to her Mum. But, before she went home, she bought an ice-cream as a reward for catching the rabbit. The little girl was so happy!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She was so happy. She had a mommy and a daddy who loved her very much. 

One day, her mommy and daddy offered her a special surprise. They offered to take her on a trip. She was so excited. 

The family drove to a place far away. As they arrived, the ground started shaking. It was an earthquake! 

The little girl was scared, but soon she realized that it was alright. Her mommy and daddy hugged her, and she was so happy. 

They finished the trip with smiles on their faces. Her mommy and daddy were so proud of how brave she had been. 

The little girl smiled, feeling so lucky to have such wonderful parents.

Once upon a time, there lived a little boy called Andy. He was an adventurous boy and always liked trying new things. He was especially curious about the world around him.

One day, Andy went to the park with his mom. As he ran around, playing with the other kids, he saw a beautiful butterfly with purple and yellow wings. He watched in amazement as it flew away and shouted with joy.

His mom was so proud of him - she smiled and clapped! This made Andy feel so special. He looked up at her and smiled back with love.

The next day, Andy decided to go on an adventure and explore the park even more. As he ventured through the woods, he heard a loud noise. To his surprise, it was the same butterfly from the day before!

Andy was so happy that he wanted to thank the butterfly. He started to applaud and waved his hands in the air with excitement. The butterfly fluttered around him, enjoying the moment.

Andy's mom was filled with pride. He had been so adventurous that day and she was so proud of him. She said, "You make me so happy Andy!" And they hugged and filled each other with love.

Once upon a time, there was a nice lady. She had an orange in her hand. She wanted to carry it to the park.

The lady was very safe. She walked slowly so that she would not fall down. She crossed the street carefully.

When she reached the park, she saw lots of children playing. She put down the orange and said, "Who wants to have some yummy orange?"

All the children came running to the orange. They laughed and giggled as they ate the orange. The lady smiled and was happy.

The lady was happy that she had carried the orange to the park. All of the children were happy too.

Once upon a time, three children went on an adventure. They wanted to prepare something special. They went to the store and looked around.

They saw a tire. It was big and round. They decided to buy it. Next they picked up some healthy food. They chose fruits, vegetables and a special treat.

The children went home and prepared their tire. First they covered it with a big blanket. Then they put the food inside. Finally, they gathered some friends and jumped. They rolled and laughed. They had a lot of fun. 

After all their playing, the children went inside for dinner. They enjoyed their healthy meal. Then they all slept with big smiles on their faces. 

The end!

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was very healthy and loved to eat beef. One day, she heard a noise coming from outside which disturbed her. 

She opened the door to find a cow in her garden! She was so excited and wanted to get a closer look, so she followed the cow. Suddenly the cow started eating a patch of grass near a bush.

The little girl realised that the cow had found some tasty beef! She was so happy and collected the beef for her dinner. She thanked the cow for showing her such a healthy food. 

And that's how the little girl got her tasty beef!

Once there was a very brave Little Bear. One day, he went on a special adventure to find a reward. He walked and walked until he saw something shiny in the distance. It was a big chest, lying next to a river! 

Little Bear was so excited. He quickly opened the chest. Inside, there were lots of shiny coins. Suddenly, something very scary jumped out of the chest. It was a dragon!

Little Bear was so scared that he wanted to run away, but he was brave and he said, "I will not run away." He bravely grabbed one of the coins and showed it to the dragon. 

The dragon sighed and flew away. Little Bear was safe! He was so happy that he knew he had found the reward. He took the coins home and showed them to his mom. 

His mom was so proud of Little Bear for being so brave and finding such a wonderful reward! Little Bear hugged his mom and they shared a very happy moment.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was three years old and full of energy. She was always curious to know what was new and different in the world.

One day, her mommy took her to the park. It was filled with so many things to explore. She saw kids playing on the swings, dogs playing catch and birds flying through the sky.

The little girl began to wonder. She wondered what each thing knew and what it was like to have those amazing adventures.

So, her mommy took her to the top of a hill. She showed the little girl a new point. It was a point of knowledge. This was a place where the little girl could see a lot of things at once.

The little girl was so excited. She was intrigued by the new point and she wanted to know more. Her mommy told her that this was a place to learn and to become a part of the world.

From then on, the little girl had so many new adventures. She learned things from the point, and she felt that she knew more about the world. The little girl became smarter, happier and more excited every day.

Once upon a time, there was a boy who loved to study. He used to sit in his room with a candle burning beside him and study late into the night. 

One night, he was feeling very uncomfortable in his chair and he couldn't quite work out why. He looked around his room and saw the flame from his candle flickering. Suddenly, he realised that the flame was too hot! 

He quickly moved the candle away from him and noticed that the room became much more comfortable. He smiled and went back to studying his book. 

From that day on he always made sure to keep his candle away from him when he was studying, so he could be comfortable. And he lived happily ever after!

Once upon a time, there was a beautiful flower who bloomed and grew tall in the garden. Every day the flower showed off her bright, yellow petals and everyone cheered when they saw her.

But one day she saw a strange symbol in the sky. It looked dangerous and the flower became scared. She quickly hid and tried to stay away from it.

The next day, the symbol was still above, but something amazing had happened. When the flower looked up, she realised that the symbol had become bright, shiny and colourful. Suddenly, the symbol wasnâ€™t scary anymore and everyone in the garden smiled and cheered.

The symbol was transformed and the flower knew that she was safe. From that day, when the sun shone bright, the flower always reminded those in the garden of the beautiful symbol in the sky and that it was never really dangerous.

Once upon a time, there lived a little girl named Alice. She liked to play games and have fun all day. One day, Alice saw a shiny handle on the ground. She picked it up and asked her mom what it was. Her mom told her it was a special handle, and it belonged to a friend of hers. 

Alice's mom asked if she wanted to lend the handle to her friend. Alice thought it would be nice to help her mom's friend, so she said yes. She put on a big smile and handed the handle to her mom. 

Alice's mom took the handle to her friend's house. When she came back, her mom said something was wrong with it and the friend was very sad. Alice asked if the handle was broken, but instead her mom said it wasn't broken, it just tasted very bitter. 

Alice was confused and asked why the handle was so bitter. Her mom explained that her friend put lemons on the handle, and they made it bitter. Alice was so sad her mom's friend was unhappy, so she decided to cheer her up. 

Alice made a big smile and gave her new friend a hug. That made the friend so happy that she forgot about the bitter handle. Alice and her mom's friend became best friends, and they had lots of fun together.

One day, Jen and her dad were in the kitchen. Jen was excited; her dad was going to make her some special pancakes. She watched as her dad mixed the ingredients. He added some sugar and eggs. Then he added something that Jen didn't recognize.

"What's that, Daddy?" she asked.

"It's pepper," her dad said. He sprinkled it into the bowl.

Jen watched as he stirred the pancake batter. He was so careful, but she could tell he was a little nervous.

Soon, the batter was ready. Her dad poured it onto the hot griddle. He made sure to separate the pancakes so they wouldn't all be stuck together.

At last, the pancakes were ready. Jen's dad sprinkles some more pepper onto the pancakes. Jen had never seen pepper on pancakes before, but it smelled delicious!

They sat together and ate their special pancakes. Jen ate three â€“ and she loved them!

Once there was a goose who felt very excited. He wanted to go out and explore the world, so he began to fly. As he flew, he saw a bright and beautiful meadow below him. He was so excited that he couldn't resist and quickly descended to the ground. But, as soon as he landed, he noticed a cat. The cat was huge and fierce-looking. He was scared and tried to fly away, but the cat was too fast for him. The goose knew he had to surrender in order to survive. He held his wings close and stopped struggling. After a few moments, the cat tired of chasing the goose and walked away. The goose was relieved and stretched his wings to fly away. But before he left, he took a moment to appreciate the beauty of the meadow.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Daisy. Daisy was three years old and loved sausages. She would always ask her Mommy for sausages for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

One day, she asked her Mommy for sausages again, but her Mom reminded her very softly that she couldn't always eat sausages for every meal. Daisy became very upset and started to cry.

Her Mommy hugged her tight and said, "You can still have sausages sometimes. Just remind me next time and I'll get you some from the store."

Daisy smiled, because she knew that even though she couldn't always eat sausages, she would still get her favourite food from time to time. So Daisy asked her Mommy for sausages every week!

Once upon a time there was an ordinary family. They had two children, who were always happy to play together.

But one day, the siblings began to quarrel. They were shouting, making a lot of noise, and not listening to each other. Mummy and Daddy were not happy and so they decided to send the children outside, away from the house. 

So they sent them to the garden to play. They asked them to make the soil nice and soft by patting it down.

The children worked together, happily and quietly. After some time, they had made the soil look beautiful. While they were playing, they stopped quarreling and started to enjoy themselves. 

Mummy and Daddy were so pleased, that they rewarded the children with a delicious ice cream. The children smiled and the family was happy again.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was sad and very miserable. She was so bored she couldn't find anything to do. Then she saw a bee buzzing in a flower.

The bee was buzzing around, but the little girl was too sad to follow it. Instead, she yawned and lay down in the sun.

After a while, the little girl began to feel better. She watched the bee and soon the boredom melted away. She smiled.

The bee helped the little girl to feel happy again. She thanked it for making her day better and waved goodbye as it flew away.

Once upon a time there was a guard. He was a very strong and brave guard and he looked after a lot of different places. One of his favourite jobs was to look after a very nosy village.

Every day he would recommend things to keep the village safe and happy. He would always remind the villagers to be polite and kind to each other.

One day, the guard was walking around the village when he heard a loud noise. He ran to the source of the sound and spotted a naughty cat. The cat was being nosy and had knocked over some things in the village.

The guard quickly sorted out the mess and then caught the cat. He brought the cat back to the village elder.

The guard recommended that the cat should go and live in a different village, far away from the nosy villagers. The elder noted his wise suggestion, and thanked the guard for his help. 

The guard bowed his head and smiled. He continued to look after the village and kept on recommending sensible things to keep it safe and happy.

Once upon a time, there was a fair peanut. It looked so tasty that a lion roared with happiness when he saw it. The lion decided to eat the peanut, so it quickly ran over to grab it. The lion roared again and again as it crunched the yummy peanut!

The lion was so happy that it decided to take the peanut and share it with its friends. So, it roared as it ran through the forest to find them. Soon, it arrived at the other lions' door and proudly presented the peanut to them.

The other lions were very pleased to receive such a fair peanut. They quickly shared it among themselves and everyone roared together in joy! They had a great time eating it, because it was the sweetest peanut around.

The lion was so pleased that it decided to share the other fair peanuts it had found. The other lions were soon so full that they could barely roar anymore! They all enjoyed the tasty peanuts and were thankful to the lion for bringing them such a fair snack.

Once upon a time, there was a humble mouse named Peanut. Peanut lived in an airport. Every day Peanut would wake up and begin to chew on the delicious food in the airport. He especially loved to chew on the peanuts he found. As he ate, Peanut watched the airplanes take off and land. He dreamed of one day flying in one of the planes.

Eventually, an airplane that was going to a far away place caught Peanut's eye. He could just imagine going on an adventure the plane was taking. Peanut kept dreaming and chewing until the plane had taken off.

Sadly, Peanut never got to ride the plane to his dream destination. But he still loved to spend time in the airport, chewing and dreaming. The End.

Once there was a sad book. The book felt left out because it couldn't do the same things as everyone else. One day, the book had a really good idea! It decided to reverse itself!

So the book stood up on its head and waggled its pages. It spun around and around until it felt dizzy. Suddenly, it was jumping! It was doing flips, twirls and cartwheels! Everyone in the room was amazed.

The book was so happy and no longer felt sad. It was doing all the same things as everyone else in the room. It was a big success! Everyone was so surprised and happy that the sad book was able to reverse itself. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy. His name was Steve. He liked to swing on the swings in the park. Every day, he would find something new and exciting to do on the swings. 

One day, Steve heard a sound. It was a loud, honking sound. He stopped swinging and looked around. He saw a man playing a trumpet. Steve was very shy, so he stayed back and watched from a distance. 

The man playing the trumpet was very talented. He smiled and played the trumpet with all of his might. Steve could feel the happy music in his heart. He started dancing and swinging to the beat. 

After the man finished playing the trumpet, Steve waved goodbye and thanked him. He was so glad to have heard such wonderful music, and he had lots of fun swinging when he heard it. 

The End.

One day, there was a deep hive in a tree. It was summertime. A honeybee was living inside the hive and was very happy. 

The honeybee flew around and gathered nectar to make honey. Then it flew back to the hive. 

But one day, something bad happened. The honeybee heard a loud noise. It was a boy hitting the hive with a stick! He was trying to get the honey in the hive. 

The bee was very sad and the hive was starting to break. The bee quickly flew out and away from the boy. 

The next day, the bee found a new, safe hive in a different tree. It made its home there, and was able to make even more honey and be very happy again.

Once there was a teddy bear. He was very hairy with big eyes. He had one special thing: a watch. It was tied around his neck with a red ribbon.

One day, a little girl came over to the teddy bear's home. She saw the watch and wanted it. She tried to lift it up, but it was too heavy. She asked the bear if he could give it to her.

The bear said he was sorry, but he said he could not give it away. He said it was very special to him and he wanted to keep it.

But then the little girl said she just wanted to play with it for a little bit. She asked if he could lift it off his neck and give it to her for a few minutes.

The bear thought about it for a minute, but then he said yes. He lifted the watch off his neck, and the little girl happily took it. She played with it for a few minutes and then gave it back to him.

The little girl said goodbye and thanked the bear. The bear thanked her too, and put his watch back around his neck. He smiled, happy to have his special watch back around his neck again.

Once there was a little girl called Emily. She was only three years old and was always very thin.

One day Emily was worried about something when she heard a loud noise outside her window. She saw a big monkey and it was trying to open the window.

Emily ran to her parent's room and told them about the monkey. Her parents were very scared and quickly locked the window.

The monkey couldn't get inside the house and Emily didn't have to worry anymore. Her parents hugged her and she felt safe inside the house.

The next day, Emily's parents added more locks to the window so that the monkey wouldn't be able to get in. Emily was happy that she didn't have to worry anymore.

Once there was a little girl named Jane. She was very envious because she didn't have her own pool like her friends. One day, Jane went to the park and saw a big pool. She was so excited, she forgot she didn't have a swimming suit. She jumped in the pool anyway and had so much fun. 

Then, the sky lit up and became orange. Jane realized there was a terrible fire and the park was burning. She had to get out of the pool fast! She swam and swam. When she reached the edge of the pool, she saw the fire was all around her. She was so scared, but then she heard someone calling her name. It was her father, and he saved her.

Jane and her father made it home safely and hugged eachother tightly. Jane loved her father very much and was so glad that he saved her. She was no longer envious of her friends' pools. She was happy with what she had in the end.

Once upon a time, there was a clumsy painter. He wanted to paint a picture of a beautiful rainbow. But he didn't know how.

So he went to ask his friend for help. He said, "Please, can you help me paint this picture?" His friend said, "Yes, I can help you!"

Then the clumsy painter and his friend got to work. They used lots of colorful paints, and worked until the picture was complete.

When the picture was finished, the clumsy painter was very happy! He said, "Thank you for helping me. I'm so glad I asked for your help!"

The end.

Once upon a time there was a group of friends who were very eager to play. They wanted to find something challenging and fun. 

So they decided to gather at the local park to play in a huge maze! It was so big and twisty and everyone was so excited. 

The friends ran around the maze as fast as they could and tried to find the way out. But it was harder than they thought! They tried and tried but every time they thought they were close to the end, they took a wrong turn. 

Eventually, the friends realised that if they worked together, they could find their way out. So they held hands and followed each other carefully. Sure enough, soon they were out of the maze and the friends were very excited! 

They all laughed and hugged one another, happy that they could find their way out. From then on, the friends decided to always gather together and try new adventures.

Once upon a time, there was a big, hot, incredible world. Imagine a world full of big, colourful mountains and lots of friendly animals and birds. Everyone was very happy, and it was a place full of fun and adventure.

One day, a little girl went exploring in the hot world and she found something incredible. As she looked around, she saw a large blue lake, filled with beautiful creatures swimming around. She took a big breath and jumped in.

The water was so warm and the little girl was so happy. She swam for hours, surrounded by incredible colours and wonderful sights. After a while, she got so tired, she decided to float on her back and let the sunshine dry her off.

It was one of the most amazing experiences of her life, and she never forgot it. She had imagined a hot, incredible world, and she discovered it.

Once upon a time, there was a boy called Tom. He was three years old. He was feeling troubled because he had to sit through a long lecture.

The lecture was about tying a rope. Tom was confused about it, so his Dad helped him learn how to tie a knot. He showed him how to wrap the rope around his fingers, make a loop and pull a loose end through the loop.

Tom practised tying the rope and soon he was getting very good at it. He was so proud of himself!

When he was done with the lecture, Tom ran outside. He shouted with joy and waved the rope he had tied in the air. He was so happy that he had learnt how to tie the rope.

Once upon a time there was a brave boy named Max. Max loved to play hide and seek with his friends. One day when Max was playing, he couldn't find his friends. He was so scared of the dark and the unknown that he ran home.

When Max walked in, his mom saw his scared look and said, "Max, you don't need to be scared. Come and sit with me." Max felt safe with his mom, so he went and sat with her.

His mom said, "Max, don't be afraid to surrender. It's ok to give up and ask for help sometimes." She then gave him an invitation. It was an invitation to a special game.

Max was excited and he soon forgot his fear. He jumped up and said, "Yes, mommy. I will play!" Max felt safe and trusted his mom so he gave himself up to the game. It was a game of hide and seek, and Max surrendered and let his mom help him find his friends. 

He found them in the end and laughed louder than before. This time, it felt safe to surrender, and Max was happy that he had taken the invitation.

Once there was a lady who had a high face. Every day she would tell the sun good morning and the stars goodnight. One day she saw a big white bird flying over her. She told it hello and it sang back. She laughed and smiled. 

Then she felt something tickling her face. She saw some high clouds in the sky and smiled. Suddenly she heard a voice telling her to look down. It was a tiny mouse who wanted to tell her something. The mouse said, "I love your face and I want to be your friend".

The lady was so happy, she gave the mouse a big hug and thanked him. They played together until the sun started to set. The lady waved goodbye to the mouse and told him to come back soon.

The lady smiled. She was so happy to have a new friend. From then on, she always had a high face.

Once upon a time, there was a nation. The people of this nation were very glad. One day, a special delivery came to the nation. It was a huge box filled with toys. Everyone was so excited and happy to get the delivery. The children ran around with the toys and played all day long, smiling and laughing. Even the grown-ups joined in the fun and laughed along with the children. The nation was very glad and everyone was having a great time. The delivery made everyone so happy that the nation was filled with joy and smiles. Everyone lived happily ever after.

Thomas was playing outside when he found a fierce cat. He decided to try to catch it and he chased it around the garden. The cat climbed a tree but Thomas had an idea. He ran inside and grabbed the remote control for the television. He waved it in front of the tree and quickly the cat came down. Thomas had caught the cat! He was so happy he hugged it and they both went inside.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jessica. She was very brave and wanted to try something new.

One day, she walked into a long, dark hallway. She was very scared, but she kept walking.

At the end of the hallway, she saw a big door. She reached out to open it. Suddenly, the door opened and she saw a room filled with silly things. Jessica was so happy!

She started to try them out when she noticed a man watching her. He seemed ignorant but she wasn't scared.

Jessica asked the man what he was doing. He said he was just watching and making sure that everyone was having fun. Jessica smiled and said thank you.

Jessica spent the rest of the day playing and trying new things. She was so excited! She was happy that she had tried something new.

Once upon a time, there was a playful sailor who lived in a big boat. He always had lots of fun, but he always had one big question. One day, he decided he would look for the answer.

So off he went, sailing and searching from sea to sea. He found many animals, but none knew the answer to his question. One day, he spotted something in the distance - an island!

He sailed to the island and saw lots of playful animals. He asked each one if they knew the answer and each one shook their head. Then, he asked a seagull.

The seagull smiled and said, "Yes, I know the answer. The answer is in your heart". The playful sailor smiled and thanked the seagull.

He headed back to his boat with a smile on his face and the answer to his question. He knew the answer was inside him all along.

John and Jane had a magazine. It was very impressive. They looked at the pictures and read all the words. John liked the cars in the magazine. Jane liked the cartoons. They both liked the stories about animals. 

John and Jane showed their magazine to Mommy. Mommy was impressed. She asked them lots of questions about the magazine, and John and Jane had the answers. 

John and Jane were very proud of their magazine. They had worked hard to make it and they thought it was the best magazine ever. They had a lot of fun with their magazine. 

John and Jane were so proud of their magazine they decided to give it to their friends. Their friends were amazed and said it was so impressive. Mommy was proud of her kids. She said they had made a special magazine.

One day, a little girl named Jenny was walking in the woods. She loved playing hide and seek with her friends.

Suddenly, Jenny heard something unfamiliar. It sounded like a strange noise. She wanted to know what it was.

Jenny began to search for the noise. She looked here and there, but nothing was to be seen. As she moved further into the woods, the sound became louder.

Soon enough, Jenny saw something shiny. It was hidden behind a tall tree. She knew she had found the sound.

Jenny ran to the hidden thing. It was a quick squirrel, who was scurrying around trying to collect as many nuts as possible.

Jenny laughed and watched the squirrel as it gathered its nuts. Then, she went back to searching the woods with her friends.

Once upon a time, there was a bunny carrot. Bunny carrot was thick and bouncy. He was always smiling and his yellow teeth shone in the sun.

One day, bunny carrot hopped down the road and met a friendly squirrel. The squirrel was very happy to meet bunny carrot and smiled at him.

Bunny carrot thought it was so cool to make a new friend, so he hopped back home. He ran to the garden and grabbed a carrot as a present for his new friend.

The next day, bunny carrot brought the carrot to the squirrel. The squirrel was so excited! He smiled at bunny carrot and thanked him for the gift.

The two friends became best friends and every day, they would play together and share carrots. They were so happy and would always smile at each other.

Once upon a time, there was a very powerful lion. He had a special suit that allowed him to roar very loudly. He was so loud that the whole jungle could hear him. Everyone was scared of him, because he was so powerful.

The lion decided to take a walk in the forest one day. As he was walking, he roared and roared. All of the animals in the jungle began to flee. Even the brave tigers ran away scared. The lion had never felt so powerful before.

He kept walking and roaring until he had enough. He stopped, took off his suit and went home. Everyone in the jungle felt safe again. 

The lion never forgot how powerful he felt that day. He kept his special suit and always remembered how much fun it was to roar.

One day, Amy was feeling very sick. She had a big fever and felt very weak. Her Mommy gave her some medicine to make her feel better. After taking it, Amy felt much better. 

Her Mommy said, "Let's go outside to get some fresh air." Together, they went to the park. There was an enormous tree in the park, and Amy was so excited. She ran over to it and jumped.

Mommy said, "We can't jump today. Let's go for a jog around the park instead!" Amy was surprise, but liked the idea. Together, they jogged around the park. It was so much fun! 

Amy was so happy that she felt better and that they had jogged around the park. Soon it was time to go home, but Amy had a lot of energy still. 

Mommy said, "Let's stay here a while longer and jog some more!" So they jogged around the park one more time, and then they went home. 

That was the best day ever!

Once there was a boy named Jake. He was three years old and loved to explore.

One day, Jake decided to explore his mum's bathroom. He saw a bottle of lotion and decided to take it. He opened the bottle and took some lotion on his hands.

Mum saw him and said, "Jake, what are you doing? That lotion is important."

Jake looked over at her and explained that he just wanted to try something new.

Mum smiled and said, "It's ok, but try using it on your skin next time."

Jake nodded and put the bottle back. He then went to play outside with his friends. 

He had learned something important that dayâ€”that lotion can help make skin soft and smooth.

One day, Bob saw a lock. He had never seen one before and he was curious. He reached forward to feel the edges and it made a click sound. Bob was a bit fearful, but he still wanted to open it. He looked around, but he didn't see anyone. He slowly and carefully twisted the lock and the lid opened with a loud creak! 

Inside he saw something sparkly, but he couldn't tell what it was. He felt around in the box, and he finally discovered some colorful stones. He excitedly brought them out and looked at them in the sunlight. 

He looked back at the lock and thought it was so cool. He didn't know how it worked, but he felt like he conquered something big. He put the box back and slowly closed the lid with a click. He smiled and moved away, feeling triumphant.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Daisy. She was three years old and she loved to spin. Every morning Daisy would spin around and around in circles. The twists and turns made her giggle and laugh.

One day Daisy noticed something strange. Off in the distance she could see fluffy clouds of blue smoke. Daisy ran to ask what it was. Her mum said it was a special type of smoke called steam.

Daisy became fascinated with the steam and she wanted to see what would happen if she spun with it. So, while the steam puffed blue in the sky, Daisy spun around and around. In and out of the smoke she spun faster and faster.

Since then, every day Daisy has played in the steam. She swirls and twirls and the blue smoke follows her. Daisy loves to spin and the steam loves her right back.

Once upon a time, there was a pink balloon. It loved to fly around in the sky, but it was lonely. One day, it went to a park to meet some new friends.

The first thing it saw was a boy playing with a ball. He noticed the balloon and asked if it wanted to play. The balloon was excited and said yes!

They started to play and the balloon was having lots of fun. But then the balloon bumped the ball too hard and the boy started to complain. He said the balloon was too rough and not being careful.

The balloon felt sad and started to cry. But the boy said he was sorry and gave it a hug. He said it was okay and told the balloon to try again.

So the balloon flew around the park, slowly and carefully. And the balloon stayed friends with the boy for many years afterwards. The end.

Once upon a time, there was an open letter that was sent to a little boy. The letter said that he had suffered something bad. The boy was sad and he cried. He called his mom to help him. His mom read the letter and explained that everyone suffers sometimes, just like the little boy did. She said that the little boy could be strong and find new ways to be happy even if he suffered. The little boy was still sad, but he was starting to feel better. Mom put her arms around him to give him a big hug and said, "Being open will help you heal." The little boy nodded and gave his mom a big hug back. He was feeling much better now. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a wild sugar. It was so sweet that even the birds wanted to eat it. But the sugar would not budge. All it did all day was sleep.

One day a little boy came along. He had three years, and was very brave. He wanted to wake up the sugar.

So he shook it and shouted. But nothing happened. The sugar was still sleeping. So the boy took some water and sprinkled it on the sugar.

Suddenly, the wild sugar woke up! It was so happy and jumped around. Then it ran away and disappeared. The little boy was so excited but all he could do was watch as the wild sugar scampered away. 
The next day, the little boy went back to the spot he had seen the wild sugar, and found a sweet treat waiting for him! The wild sugar had left a surprise for him - a little sugary treat.

Once upon a time there was good person. He loved to zoom around with his friends on his bike. One day, he stopped at a store and bought himself a big cup of yogurt. As he was eating it he was feeling embarrassed because it was chocolate yogurt and he liked plain. Suddenly, he zoomed away.

His friends were laughing when they saw him go. They thought it was funny that he had bought such a silly kind of yogurt. But they were also happy because they knew that he enjoyed it eventhough he felt a little embarrassed. 

Soon, they were all zooming around together, eating their yogurt as they had a lot of fun. After that, they all said goodbye and zoomed home. 

The end.

Once there was a little girl named Mia. She was feeling very anxious because she saw something strange in her backyard - a tunnel!
 Mia wanted to fix it and make it better.

She walked up to the tunnel and said "Let's fix it together!"

Mia started to fill up the tunnel with dirt, using her hands and a shovel. She worked really hard and was very careful not to cover up any creatures that were living there.

After she filled the tunnel up all the way, Mia stepped back and looked at her work. The tunnel was fixed! She was so proud of herself and smiled with joy.

Mia had made a big difference and was very happy. From then on, she always tried to fix things that needed help.

Once there was a silver fox. Every day the fox would wander through the forest looking for food. One day he stopped in front of a huge tree, but no matter how hard he tried, he couldn't climb it. He felt so sad.

Suddenly he saw a strange creature. It was small, silver, and had long ears. The fox knew that it was a bunny and he said, "Hello", but the bunny just hopped away. 

The fox kept walking and soon found a small stream. He stopped to take a drink, but when he looked in the water, he saw the bunny again. This time, the bunny was swimming! The fox was so surprised and he wanted to swim too. 

The fox tried to swim, but he found it hard. He tried and tried until eventually he could swim quite well. With each day, the fox was getting better and better and he was so happy! 

The silver fox kept swimming and soon he became the best swimmer in the forest. He was so proud of himself and all the other animals in the forest were amazed by his skill. The fox was no longer sad and his happiness continued to increase.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Anna. Anna was only three years old, but she already knew what she wanted. One day, Anna was playing in the garden and she saw an exciting maze. She asked her mum if she could go in, but her mum said no.

Anna was very sad but she didn't give up. She kept asking her mum until her mum finally said yes. Anna was so happy that she ran straight in to the maze. She went around the corners and down the paths, giggling as she went.

But Anna soon found out the maze was much bigger than it seemed. She got lost and couldn't find her way out. After a while, Anna became very scared. Then she heard her mum's voice.

Her mum was standing at the entrance, insisting that Anna come out. But Anna wanted to stay. She wanted to solve the maze and be brave. So her mum made a deal: if Anna came out now, she would come back again soon with Anna's dad and they would solve the maze together.

Anna accepted the deal. She followed her mum out of the maze. Then, a few days later, she returned with her dad who had a mild look on his face. Together, they ran around the maze, laughing and finding their way out. Anna felt so proud and happy that she had insisted on solving the maze!

A battery sat in a small room, alone. Then a graceful woman arrived - she was excited to see it. She picked up the battery, feeling its weight in her hands, and then placed it on the table.

The battery seemed to know what was about to happen, and it started bouncing up and down. The woman chuckled happily, and soon the whole room was filled with the sound of her joy.

The woman then reached for a small box, opening its lid. She carefully placed the battery inside, before connecting a few wires. Suddenly, the room was illuminated with bright lights.

The woman was delighted. It felt as though the simple battery had given her an unexpected gift of light. She thanked the battery, then ran out of the room in excitement.

The battery watched its new friend leave, happy to have had the chance to make someone smile. It then gently rested in its new home, content and graceful.

Once upon a time, there was a little car. It was very excited for the race about to start. The car had made sure to get up early to get ready.

The car was just about to start when it saw another car. This car was very slow and kept delaying the start of the race. The slow car was only able to inch forward.

The little car was getting very impatient with the slow car. It wanted to start the race right away, but it had to be patient because the slow car could not go any faster.

Eventually, the little car and the slow car were ready, and the race began. The little car was finally able to drive as fast as it wanted and crossed the finish line first! It had been worth the delay!

Susie was playing at the beach. She picked up a shell and held it in her hand. She could feel how smooth and hard it was and it looked so pretty. She thought it would be a great toy to play with. 

Susie carried the shell around the beach and stopped to look at all the other shells. She put her shell down and paused to look around. She saw a healthy looking seagull flying around in the bright blue sky. 

Susie decided to take her shell and explore the other parts of the beach. She wanted to find more shells like the one she was holding. She looked and looked and eventually found another shell, but this one was bigger than the one she already had! 

Susie smiled as she looked around the beach. She had a lot of healthy shells to play with now. She was so happy that she decided to stay a bit longer and enjoy her new shells.

Once upon a time, there was a humble mushroom. He lived in a special forest where all the animals believed in him. Every day, Squirrel and Fox would come to visit him. They would sit with Mushroom and talk about the forest and their families.

One day, Bunny hopped into the forest. As soon as he saw the mushroom, Bunny knew they were going to become special friends. Bunny started to tell Mushroom stories and Rabbit believed every single one.

The three new friends were so happy together. Mushroom was so proud of his two new friends, Squirrel and Bunny. He was glad that he could help them believe.

The friendship between the three stayed strong, and each of them took care of the other. Even though Mushroom was only a humble mushroom, he was very special to them.

Once upon a time there was a clumsy staff. Its name was Clumsy. Tom and Jill had never seen a staff like Clumsy before. They fed Clumsy some nice treats and wanted to play with it.

Jill wanted to hold Clumsy, so Tom gave it to her. But Clumsy was so clumsy that it slipped out of Jill's hands and fell on the ground.

Tom and Jill were sad when the clumsy staff was broken. So the two friends decided to make a new staff for Clumsy.

They took some sticks and tied them together. Tom and Jill painted it beautiful colors and called it "New Clumsy". Then they gave it back to the clumsy staff.

From that day forward, Clumsy was never clumsy anymore. Tom and Jill were happy and enjoyed playing with New Clumsy!

Once upon a time there was a little boy called Peter. One day Peter went for a walk in the countryside. He walked and walked and soon he saw something strange. There were lots of peppers growing on a bush! So Peter decided to pick some and he filled his pockets with as many as he could. 

On his way home he heard a noise. It was a strange sound and it made Peter panic. He started to run but the peppers kept bouncing out of his pockets. Before long he had lost them all!

Peter was very sad that he had lost his peppers but then he noticed something useful. There were lots of pepper plants growing near where the peppers had bounced out of his pocket. Peter was very happy! He picked some more peppers and made his way home with a pocket full of peppers. 

He was so relieved he had found more peppers, he never wanted to panic like that again! So from then on, he always remembered to be careful when he was picking peppers.

One winter, there was a sad girl. She wanted to write something, but she didn't know what to write. She thought and thought, but nothing came to her. Then she had an idea! She would write about the winter. 

She looked around and noticed the cold snow on the ground and the white fluffy clouds in the sky. She thought about the icy wind blowing and the frost adding sparkles to everything. She took out her pen and paper, and started to write. She wrote about all the things she saw and felt outside, everything she was so sad about. 

When she was finished, she read it over and smiled. She felt better, like she knew the winter better now. She put her paper away, and went inside to get warm and have a snack.

Mommy and Bobby were in a hurry. Bobby had a big, colorful box and he was so excited to open it. Inside were two squishy round things. Mommy said they were "lungs". Bobby kept asking what they were and why they were so colorful. Mommy said that the colorful lungs were going to help Bobby run faster. She said that when Bobby ran and took big breaths, the colorful lungs would help him breathe better and he could go faster. Bobby was very excited and could not wait to try them out. He grabbed the colorful lungs and ran outside to find out how fast he could go. He was so surprised at how fast he was running - he had never gone that fast before. He was running so fast even Mommy couldn't keep up!

Once there was a forgetful bear who lived near a lake. One day, the bear was feeling bored so he thought he'd go explore the lake. As he stepped into the lake, a magical spell began to happen. The bear started to shrink and shrink until he was the same size as a 3 year old! The lake was full of fun and adventure now that the bear was so small. 

He tried swimming in the lake, and then he walked around the shore, looking for something exciting to do. He watched some fish swimming in the lake and some birds flying overhead. The bear spent the whole day exploring the lake, having a great time. 

But then, the spell started to wear off and the bear began to grow again. He wasn't feeling bored anymore, and had lots of stories to tell his friends! The bear never forgot his special day at the lake.

Once there was a family who liked to celebrate. Every week, they would celebrate something, whether it was in the attic or outside.

The family had many decorations and things to use for their celebrations. They had sparkly streamers and colorful balloons. On some days they even wore silly hats!

Their mom was very patient while they were partying. She helped them blow up the balloons and hung the streamers. She answered all their questions and was always patient when things didn't go as planned.

At the end of each celebration, the family always gathered in the attic for one last party. They would laugh and dance until it was time to leave.

The family had so much fun celebrating new adventures and memories together.

John had a twin brother, Adam. They loved to play together every day and they always shared their toys. John was a generous twin and always let Adam have the first turn. One day, they went to the park and Adam had an idea. He said, "Let's play a game! We'll find something to stare at and then see who can stare the longest." John agreed and they each looked around the park until they found something to stare at.

Adam spotted a bird and chose the bird as their target. They both started to stare. Adam thought he was winning, but John was determined to be the winner. He kept on his focusing. He didn't blink once. Finally, after what felt like hours, Adam looked away and gave up. John had won the game! Adam was surprised and clapped for his brother in admiration. He said, "You won because you were generous with me. Thank you for sharing this game with me, John." John and Adam hugged and headed off home after a fun day.
